fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-03-31 (afternoon, 13:55): The complainant found the pocket emptied of cash (about Rs. 12,000) after boarding a crowded bus near Mullai Colony Shopping Complex. A person named Balaji Karuppasamy, associated with the number 9000000407, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect reportedly bumped into the victim while another person took the purse.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, mobile number, CCTV, shopping complex, photograph, afternoon, suspect
